deterministic_intent: Implement the confirmed three-layer Joyflow anti-deviation lifecycle as a narrow extension of the existing human-semiautomatic repository skeleton.

human_semantic_layer.objective: Prevent product meaning from drifting as it passes from the user to Brain, from Brain to Codex, and from Codex evidence back to Brain and the user.
human_semantic_layer.expected_user_result: The user confirms concrete product behavior once, receives one complete execution Prompt, reviews only real product experience, and can trust that technical freedom did not silently change product meaning.
user_flow: User describes the desired result in ordinary language.
Brain reverse-restates concrete use, success, failure, preserved behavior, and excluded behavior.
User confirms product meaning, positive and negative examples, tradeoffs, and acceptance steps.
Brain compiles dual-layer contract, meaning delta, Golden Cases, and user acceptance plan.
Non-LEAN Codex returns a short read-only interpretation before implementation.
Brain releases one complete execution Prompt after alignment.
Codex implements, checks, and returns evidence plus deviation classification.
Brain reviews original problem, semantic and scope drift, overdesign, and practically-wrong risk.
User performs the predefined real product acceptance steps and remains final closer.
business_rules: Material ambiguity means ambiguity that can change product result, user flow, data meaning, scope, risk, tradeoff, or acceptance.
Natural language expresses product meaning; mechanical fields bind execution boundaries; Golden Cases anchor behavior.
Codex controls equivalent technical implementation only inside the confirmed product and mechanical boundary.
Product rules, user flow, data meaning, feature set, important experience, material risk, and accepted tradeoffs require user decision.
Brain semantic review and user product acceptance remain separate from machine checks.
LEAN work avoids a separate handshake only when product meaning and shared behavior cannot change.
Repository facts retain stable reusable product truth, not AI thought process.
accepted_tradeoffs: Non-LEAN work adds one short read-only interpretation transfer to prevent early misunderstanding.
A small set of explicit semantic artifacts is added to the repository for traceability and validation.
Mechanical validation proves structure and consistency, while Brain and the user retain semantic and experiential judgment.
This GitHub change is a candidate implementation; a separately frozen standalone package requires its own later build and independent review.
non_goals: Do not create autonomous background execution or an automatic product decision maker.
Do not create enterprise multi-user governance or identity infrastructure.
Do not make every harmless wording difference a blocker.
Do not require the user to approve paths, functions, or internal schema details.
Do not store AI chain-of-thought or complete chat transcripts as product facts.
Do not reuse the frozen v4.3.5 package identity for modified content.
correct_examples: The same Golden Case ID appears in contract, Codex interpretation, tests, Brain review, and human acceptance.
A known-path low-risk correction embeds interpretation fields in one complete Prompt without a separate transfer only after every LEAN eligibility condition is mechanically true.
An equivalent local implementation is reported as AUTO_ACCEPTABLE_TECHNICAL_VARIATION and does not require user approval.
An unexpected shared-state or interface consequence stops at BRAIN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
A product-flow or product-rule change stops at USER_DECISION_REQUIRED and records a meaning delta before successor execution.
Brain blocks a technically passing PR when it no longer solves the original user problem.
incorrect_examples: A technically passing PR implements a rewritten problem.
Codex expands a small tool into a broad platform because the requirement said flexible.
Brain rewrites the full requirement and silently changes an unchanged business rule.
The user is asked to review internal implementation details instead of real product behavior.
Every typo or local test correction is forced through the full non-LEAN process.
A contract self-declares LEAN with one boolean while product, flow, data, shared-state, path, risk, or expected-result conditions remain unproven.
Validator declares subjective user experience correct without human testing.

must_preserve: Web Brain owns semantic clarification and product-scope judgment.
Local Codex remains the bounded executor.
Human transfer and final acceptance remain mandatory.
GitHub remains the durable PR and baseline surface.
The bridge remains the only formal mutation carrier.
Subject core retains its existing exact shape.
allowed_solution_surfaces: spec lifecycle, rule, node, edge, and semantic-closure sources
scripts routing, bridge, context, packet, semantic validation, and reconcile logic
runtime semantic closure and generated execution artifacts
observer semantic review and acceptance evidence
forbidden_consequences: No autonomous implementation, merge, or deployment controller.
No new semantic agent or duplicate execution carrier.
No mandatory separate handshake for every mechanically eligible LEAN task.
No self-authorized LEAN bypass from a single authored boolean.
No persistence of hidden AI reasoning as durable product truth.
No weakening of allowed-path, branch, PR, evidence, or final-human-closure rules.
required_outcomes: Product meaning closure has a confirmed no-material-ambiguity gate.
Translation contract contains both required layers.
Meaning delta, Golden Cases, and contract-time user acceptance are first-class artifacts.
Non-LEAN execution requires aligned Codex interpretation.
LEAN embedded interpretation is valid only when all low-risk, known-path, bounded-scope, no-product-change, no-flow-change, no-data-change, no-shared-state-change, and exact-result fields are true.
One generated Codex execution Prompt contains all meaning and mechanical boundaries needed for execution.
Deviation routing distinguishes technical variation, Brain review, and user decision.
Brain semantic review re-checks the original problem, drift, overdesign, and practically-wrong risk.
Reconcile requires machine evidence, Brain semantic review, predefined user acceptance coverage, and final human closure.
allowed_technical_freedom: Equivalent Python organization inside the modified scripts.
Equivalent JSON representation that preserves required fields and cross-references.
Additional local assertions or test cases that do not change product meaning.
Local documentation wording improvements that preserve the confirmed walkthrough and business rules.
stop_conditions: Stop when product meaning is unconfirmed or material ambiguity remains.
Stop when Codex interpretation is not aligned and no mechanically proven LEAN embedding applies.
Stop when LEAN is declared but any required eligibility field is false or missing.
Stop when implementation requires a product rule, flow, data meaning, feature, experience, material risk, or tradeoff change.
Stop when solution surface expansion, shared state, interfaces, or maintenance consequences exceed the contract.
Stop when required Golden Cases or user acceptance mappings cannot be preserved.
Stop when changed files exceed allowed paths or the branch is the default branch.
evidence_requirements: Generated single Prompt and bridge-hash relation.
User acceptance receipt covering the predefined plan before final closure.

lean_eligibility.basis: This protocol update changes product-semantic workflow, review routing, and shared execution rules, so it is intentionally non-LEAN despite known paths and a bounded result.

translated_engineering_scope: tests and mechanical GitHub check configuration
deliverables: Contract-time user acceptance and reconcile coverage gate
acceptance_checks: All semantic artifacts parse and satisfy required structure.
All semantic closure task IDs and Golden Case references match.
Confirmed meaning has no material unknowns.
The bridge binds exact semantic artifact paths.
Non-LEAN execution is blocked unless interpretation_status is ALIGNED.

The generated Codex packet is one complete Prompt and contains original problem, walkthrough, both contract layers, interpretation, Golden Cases, user acceptance, deviation routing, paths, checks, and evidence format.
LEAN is accepted only when every mechanical eligibility field is true; a boolean alone cannot bypass the handshake.
Reconcile blocks when Brain semantic review or predefined user acceptance is incomplete.
No additional subject core file or alternate execution carrier is added.
All changed files remain inside allowed paths plus generated operational artifacts.
Repository-changing work is on a non-default branch.
bash tests/run_checks.sh outputs JOYFLOW_CHECKS_PASS after generated artifacts are refreshed.
forbidden: Do not bypass semantic closure validation.
Do not weaken existing branch, allowed-path, PR, or evidence checks.
Do not claim the frozen standalone package has been regenerated by this repository PR.
Do not mark user acceptance complete before the user performs it.
forbidden_outcomes: Product meaning changes without a confirmed meaning delta.
Codex starts non-LEAN mutation before aligned interpretation.
A self-declared LEAN boolean bypasses the interpretation gate without complete eligibility proof.
A broader system is created than the user approved.
A technically passing but practically wrong result reaches closure.
The user must assemble multiple execution Prompt fragments.
AI reasoning logs become durable product truth.
must_not_infer: Do not infer new product features.
Do not infer enterprise governance requirements.
Do not infer that mechanical PASS equals product acceptance.
Do not infer that every technical difference needs user approval.
Do not infer that every task needs a separate interpretation transfer.
Do not infer LEAN eligibility from one authored boolean.
human_observation_points: The final product walkthrough is concrete and matches the user's intent.
The generated execution Prompt is a single complete block.
A truly LEAN example remains lightweight while an ineligible self-declaration is blocked.
A product-changing example returns to the user.
Brain review can reject a technically correct but practically wrong result.
Repository durable facts do not contain AI thought process.
